title: ReliST: A model-agnostic risk layer for spatial transcriptomics deconvolution.
snippet: Spatial transcriptomics deconvolution maps cell-type abundance across tissue, but most outputs do not indicate which local predictions can be trusted. We developed ReliST, a model-agnostic risk layer that preserves base predictions while assigning spot-level risk from output ambiguity, local inconsistency, and reference-related evidence.
